subjects.description: Deformed, missing, duplicated or replaced vehicles, road users or scene objects; changed paint colors; altered proportions, orientation, trajectories or relative distances.
subjects.appearance_details: Repainted signs or lane markings, unreadable invented text, melted vehicle details, ghosting, excessive smoothing and artificial material textures.

background_setting: Changed road geometry, displaced lane boundaries, moving road markings, warped buildings, invented or missing objects, deep standing water, large-area flooding, flawless mirrored roads, dry asphalt, snow, ice, dense fog and whiteout.

aesthetics.color_scheme: Unnatural color casts, excessive saturation, crushed blacks, overexposure, globally washed-out colors, random brightness changes and changing vehicle colors.
aesthetics.patterns: Regular parallel rain lines, thick bright streaks, repeating particle textures, stationary airborne droplets, uniform screen-space rain overlays, full-frame blur, tiling and flickering road reflections.

temporal_caption: Flicker, object identity drift, abrupt weather changes, unstable road geometry, jumping lens droplets, splashes disconnected from tires, stationary spray despite vehicle motion, changing traffic signals and discontinuous camera motion.
physical_realism: Windshield wipers, invented windshield or cabin structures, camera housings, large opaque optical droplets, lens-wide water smears, persistent obstruction, exaggerated halos, uniform full-frame spray, physically impossible reflections, water flowing against gravity, deep flood waves and changed camera viewpoints.
